note: Copied by hand from the official pages below on the retrieval date. Prices change; re-read the sources before deploying. USD unless marked EUR; Hetzner prices exclude VAT.

render.postgres_disk_sizes_note: 1 GB or a multiple of 5 GB; autoscaling adds 50% at 90% full, rounded up to a multiple of 5 GB
render.bandwidth_note: Service-initiated traffic to the public internet is billed, including uploads to object storage outside Render; only same-region Amazon S3 or Google Cloud Storage traffic is exempt. Inbound traffic is free.
render.free_plan_limits: Free web services spin down after 15 minutes idle and lose local files; free Postgres expires 30 days after creation and has no backups.

cloudflare_r2.rounding: usage rounded up to the next billing unit (GB-month, million requests)
